Setting.Name: D724::API::Enabled
Setting.Description: Enable the fail-closed D724 API authorization core.

Setting.Name: D724::API::TokenTTLMax
Setting.Description: Maximum OAuth client-credentials access token lifetime in seconds.

Setting.Name: D724::API::RateLimitMax
Setting.Description: Maximum configured requests per client per minute.

Setting.Name: D724::API::BcryptCost
Setting.Description: Bcrypt cost for API client secrets.

Setting.Name: D724::API::TokenRetentionDays
Setting.Description: Days to retain revoked or expired API token digests.

Setting.Name: D724::API::RateRetentionHours
Setting.Description: Hours to retain completed API rate windows.

Setting.Name: D724::API::MetricsEnabled
Setting.Description: Record bounded-cardinality API route latency and status metrics.

Setting.Name: D724::API::MetricRetentionHours
Setting.Description: Hours to retain completed API route metric windows.

Setting.Name: D724::API::LatencyWarningMs
Setting.Description: Maximum route latency in milliseconds before API health warns.

Setting.Name: D724::API::ErrorRateWarningPercent
Setting.Description: Five-minute server error percentage that raises an API health warning.

Setting.Name: D724::API::MinimumAlertRequests
Setting.Description: Minimum five-minute request volume before error-rate alerting.

Setting.Name: PublicFrontend::Module###PublicD724API
Setting.Description: Public transport endpoint for the tenant-safe D724 API.
